label: Sine tone (440 Hz)
blurb: The audio equivalent of hello world: a one-second A4 sine.

label: Print to console
blurb: Just stdout. A real Hello World.

label: Note stream melody
blurb: A C-major run played straight from an inline note stream.

label: Chord progression
blurb: A ii–V–I in C with chord brackets, played as audio.

label: Abide With Me
blurb: A shortened version of the hymn, by Henry Francis Lyte.

label: K.K Ragtime
blurb: A version of K.K Ragtime by Tom Brier, transcribed by 'Czarek7711'.

label: Yoshi's Island Athletic Theme
blurb: A version of the Yoshi's Island Athletic Theme by Tom Brier, transcribed by 'Czarek7711'.

label: Blue Shuffle (12-bar blues)
blurb: An original 12-bar blues in C with a swing feel — swung lead licks over a walking bass and backbeat comps.

label: Windy field soundscape
blurb: Pure buffer DSP — filtered noise, gusts, granular grass, reverb, delay and panning build an ambient field with a distant bird call.

label: Choir of circuits (vocal synthesis)
blurb: The `sing` formant synthesizer builds a vowel choir and a na-na-ta lead over a soft synth pad — no samples, so it plays right in your browser. Expect a charmingly retro, robotic vocoder voice.
